crossRefs.note: Then I returned and saw vanity under the sun.
There is a grievous evil which I have seen under the sun: wealth kept by its owner to his harm.
There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, and it is heavy on men:
This is an evil in all that is done under the sun, that there is one event to all: yes also, the heart of the sons of…
Moreover I saw under the sun, in the place of justice, that wickedness was there; and in the place of righteousness…
Then I returned and saw all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and behold, the tears of those who were…

translations.web: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, the sort of error which proceeds from the ruler.
translations.bsb: There is an evil I have seen under the sun— an error that proceeds from the ruler:
translations.kjv: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, as an error which proceedeth from the ruler:
translations.asv: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, as it were an error which proceedeth from the ruler:
